summary: VersaBank filed a Form 6-K with a press release announcing management's participation in the Raymond James US Bank and Banking on Tech Conference in Chicago from September 8-10, 2026, for one-on-one meetings. This is a routine investor-relations announcement with no special-situation implications such as acquisitions, divestitures, capital actions, or management changes. The filing contains no deal terms or transactional details. As a routine conference participation notice, this does not qualify as a special situation under the classification framework. No further action or analysis is warranted.
